route_title: 29-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 defect-cavity bandpass filter with refined cavity optimization
compilation_rationale: Compiled 29-layer alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 stack per fixed sequence. Initialized optimizable layers to 150 nm, a quarter-wave proxy near 1550 nm. Bounds enforced at 50–400 nm. Spectrum extended to 1380–1720 nm for 401 points to mitigate edge artifacts. Target thresholds set to strict physical limits (0.0/1.0). Relative tolerance defaults to 1%. Grid-sweep initialization noted for external workflow hooks.
